title: Deep Learning-Enhanced Real-Time Wi-Fi Sensing Through Single Transceiver Pair
abstract: arXiv:2511.02845v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The advancement of next-generation Wi-Fi technology heavily relies on sensing capabilities, which play a pivotal role in enabling sophisticated applications. In response to the growing demand for large-scale deployments, contemporary Wi-Fi sensing systems strive to achieve high-precision perception while maintaining minimal bandwidth consumption and antenna count requirements. Remarkably, various deep learning-driven perception technologies have demonstrated the ability to surpass conventional resolution limits. However, the theoretical underpinnings of this phenomenon have not been thoroughly investigated in existing research. We find that under hardware-constrained conditions, the performance gains of deep learning in Wi-Fi sensing primarily originate from two aspects: prior information and temporal correlation, which act as specific forms of side information that reduce the estimation error bound. translated_title: 基于单收发对的深度学习增强实时Wi-Fi感知
translated_abstract: 下一代Wi-Fi技术的发展在很大程度上依赖于感知能力，感知能力在实现各类复杂应用中发挥着关键作用。为满足大规模部署日益增长的需求，当代Wi-Fi感知系统力求在保持最小带宽消耗和最少天线数量的同时实现高精度感知。值得注意的是，各种深度学习驱动的感知技术已展现出超越传统分辨率极限的能力。然而，现有研究尚未对这一现象的理论基础进行深入探究。我们发现，在硬件受限条件下，深度学习在Wi-Fi感知中的性能提升主要源于两个方面：先验信息和时间相关性，它们作为特定形式的边信息降低了估计误差界。我们构建了一个深度学习……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了硬件受限条件下深度学习在Wi-Fi感知中超越传统分辨率极限的理论基础——性能提升源于先验信息与时间相关性这两种作为边信息的因素降低了估计误差界，并据此构建了仅需单收发对的深度学习增强实时Wi-Fi感知系统。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the theoretical basis for deep learning surpassing conventional resolution limits in Wi-Fi sensing—performance gains stem from prior information and temporal correlation acting as side information that reduces the estimation error bound—and accordingly builds a deep learning-enhanced real-time Wi-Fi sensing system requiring only a single transceiver pair.
